description: Returns the recorded lines from the scorecards where two named teams played each other, in any season, each with an evidenceId. Call it for the head-to-head between two teams, or before you state a fact about it.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

team_a.description: First team name or partial name to resolve. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

team_b.description: Second team name or partial name to resolve. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_matchup
title: Recent results between two teams
